obligation: CISA report of a cybersecurity incident (TSA rail directive)
citation: SD 1580-21-01E Sec. II.C.1 to II.C.4; C-TRANSPORTATION-R01
trigger: Cybersecurity incident involving IT or OT systems the company operates or maintains: unauthorized access, malicious software, denial of service, or any incident that results in or could result in operational disruption. Includes events still under investigation (Sec. IV.C). Ransomware on CAD/CTC, the BOS, or corporate IT qualifies
deadline: As soon as practicable and no later than 72 hours after the company identifies the incident (company target: 24 hours where facts allow, so it also satisfies 1570.203)
notify: CISA Central through www.cisa.gov/report or (844) 729-2472. The report must say it is made to satisfy the reporting requirements of the Security Directive
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - freight railroad in 49 CFR 1580.101(b)

obligation: Supplemental CISA report
trigger: Required report content not available at the time of the initial report (for example earliest date of compromise, indicators, impact on train operations, reversion to manual operations)
deadline: Within 24 hours of the information becoming available
applies_at_this_tier: Yes

obligation: TSA report of a significant security concern (cyber attack)
citation: 49 CFR 1570.203(a)(1) and (c); Appendix A to part 1570 ("Cyber Attack"); C-TRANSPORTATION-S01
trigger: Compromising, or attempting to compromise or disrupt, the company's information or technology infrastructure
deadline: Within 24 hours of initial discovery, as soon as possible. A CISA report under the directive that names the directive satisfies this duty for the same incident (SD 1580-21-01E Sec. II.C.5), so the CISA report must go within 24 hours or a TSOC report must be made
notify: TSA by the method TSA prescribes (Transportation Security Operations Center by telephone)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - freight railroad under 49 CFR 1580.1(a)(1)

obligation: Early notice to TSA recommended by IC Surface-2025-01
citation: TSA Information Circular IC Surface-2025-01 (2025-10-25), described in the TSA notice at FR Doc. 2026-17894 (2026-09-01); SD 1580-21-01E footnote 5
trigger: Actual or potential significant cybersecurity incident
deadline: As soon as possible and no more than 12 hours after discovery (recommended, not mandatory). Company practice: the Security Coordinator makes this call, which also starts the 1570.203 report
notify: TSA Transportation Security Operations Center by telephone (1-866-655-7023, as published in the notice)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - adopted as company practice

obligation: Notice to TSA that a directive measure cannot be implemented on time
trigger: An incident or its recovery prevents the company from carrying out a measure in the directive within the required timeframe
deadline: Immediately
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - for example if an incident delays a CIP milestone

obligation: TSA report of unauthorized SSI release
trigger: SSI (CIP, CAP, assessment results, network designs, incident reports) released to unauthorized persons, for example exfiltrated by the attacker or posted on a leak site
deadline: Promptly
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if SSI was on an affected system or in exfiltrated data

obligation: RSSM location and shipping information during the incident
trigger: TSA requests location and shipping information for RSSM cars (PIH tank cars) in the company's custody
deadline: No later than 30 minutes after the request (railroad other than Class I)
notify: TSA (requesting official), by an accepted method; the 24/7 NOC number is the contact
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - the duty continues during the outage; use the standby extract and printed list

obligation: Report of en route PTC failure or cut-out to the host railroad
trigger: A controlling locomotive on the host Class I's PTC segment has a PTC failure or cut-out en route, including loss of the tenant BOS
deadline: As soon as safe and practicable
notify: Designated railroad officer of the host railroad
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if a company train is on the trackage-rights segment when PTC service is lost

obligation: FRA telephonic report of certain accidents/incidents
trigger: Only if the incident leads to an event in 225.9(a), for example a death of a railroad employee, death or injury of 5 or more persons, or a train accident with damage of $150,000 or more
deadline: Immediately (as soon as possible after the determination or estimate is made)
applies_at_this_tier: Only if a reportable accident/incident results. A cyber attack alone is not reportable under part 225

obligation: FRA monthly accident/incident report
trigger: Any reportable rail equipment, highway-rail grade crossing, or injury accident/incident during the incident period
deadline: Within 30 days after the end of the month in which it occurred
applies_at_this_tier: Only if a reportable accident/incident results

obligation: Hazardous materials incident notice
trigger: A reportable hazmat incident under 171.15(b), for example a release from a PIH car that causes a hospitalization or a public evacuation of 1 hour or more
deadline: As soon as practical but no later than 12 hours after the occurrence
applies_at_this_tier: Only if a hazmat incident occurs

obligation: Florida breach notice to individuals
trigger: Breach of security of personal information of Florida residents (employee records including certification and medical data; payroll; customer contact data with account credentials)
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination of the breach (15 more days are possible for this notice only, if good cause is given to the Department of Legal Affairs in writing within 30 days, 501.171(3)(a))
notify: Affected Florida residents (current and former employees, customer contacts)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if personal information was accessed

obligation: Florida notice to the Department of Legal Affairs
trigger: Breach affecting 500 or more individuals in Florida
deadline: No later than 30 days after determination of the breach
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if 500 or more (likely if the ERP or HR files are taken: 850 current employees plus former employees)

obligation: Florida notice to consumer reporting agencies
trigger: Notice required to more than 1,000 individuals at one time
deadline: Without unreasonable delay
applies_at_this_tier: Only if more than 1,000

obligation: Third-party agent breach notice to the company (inbound)
trigger: A vendor holding company personal information (ERP and payroll SaaS, TMS, crew management vendor) has a breach
deadline: No later than 10 days after the vendor determines the breach
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - track in vendor contracts (STD-03)

obligation: Other states' breach notification laws
citation: Each state where affected individuals reside
trigger: Personal information of residents of other states (for example former employees who moved, or customer contacts in neighboring states)
deadline: Varies by state; counsel applies each state's law to the affected list
notify: Affected residents; state regulators where required
applies_at_this_tier: Check every breach; Florida is the worked example above

obligation: OFAC sanctions check before any ransom payment
citation: OFAC Updated Advisory on Potential Sanctions Risks for Facilitating Ransomware Payments (2021-09-21); 31 CFR ch. V
trigger: Considering a ransom payment
deadline: Before any payment; full and timely reporting to law enforcement or CISA is a mitigating factor
notify: OFAC (license if a sanctioned party is involved); FBI or CISA
applies_at_this_tier: Yes

obligation: Voluntary report to the FBI
trigger: Ransomware or extortion
deadline: As soon as practical (company practice: same day, through counsel)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - voluntary; supports the investigation and OFAC mitigation

obligation: Cyber insurance claim notice
citation: Cyber insurance policy (contract); $15 million limit, $500,000 retention
trigger: Suspected security incident
deadline: Before engaging incident response vendors; use the carrier hotline
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual, not legal

obligation: Shared dispatch service clients
citation: Services agreements with the 2 affiliated short lines and (from 2027-01-01) the contracted short line (contract)
trigger: Security incident affecting the shared dispatch or car management service, or a dispatch outage
deadline: Notice within 24 hours of the company confirming the incident; restoration of dispatch within 2 hours
notify: Each client railroad's designated operations and security contacts
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual, not legal

obligation: Host railroad and interchange partners
citation: Trackage rights agreement and interchange agreements (contract)
trigger: Incident affecting PTC operation on the host's line, the PTC messaging link, or interchange EDI
deadline: As the agreements require; in practice an operations call at once and a written notice the same day
notify: Host Class I and the 2 interchange Class I railroads
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual, not legal

obligation: Proposed TSA surface cyber incident report
trigger: Reportable cybersecurity incident
deadline: Proposed: no later than 24 hours after identification
applies_at_this_tier: No - proposed rule only; no final rule as of 2026-09-26

obligation: CIRCIA incident and ransom payment reports
citation: 6 U.S.C. 681b; proposed 6 CFR part 226 (89 FR 23644); C-TRANSPORTATION-R07
trigger: Covered cyber incident or ransom payment
deadline: Proposed: 72 hours; 24 hours after a ransom payment
applies_at_this_tier: No - final rule not published as of 2026-09-25. As proposed, it would cover this railroad

obligation: SEC cybersecurity incident disclosure
trigger: Material cybersecurity incident
deadline: Within 4 business days after determining materiality
applies_at_this_tier: No - privately held; the PE sponsor and lenders are informed under their agreements instead

obligation: Federal contract reporting (covered telecommunications; Kaspersky)
trigger: Covered equipment or a covered article discovered
deadline: 52.204-25(d): within 1 business day, then 10 business days. 52.204-23(c): within 3 business days, then 10 business days
applies_at_this_tier: No - the company holds no federal contracts
